Unfortunately, SGK subsequently failed to load the sideboard onto the scheduled delivery vehicle. We fully appreciate how frustrating this was and have raised the matter with them.  
  
We would also like to clarify the point regarding communication. We received your email at approximately 16:30 on 22 September and replied at 17:04 the same day, approximately 34 minutes later. As you mention receiving no response, it appears our reply may not have reached your main inbox, so we would kindly ask you to check your spam/junk folder. [...] Considering 274 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the beautiful craftsmanship, unique designs, and overall high quality of the solid wood furniture pieces. Many people also highlight the straightforward ordering process alongside the responsive and helpful communication from the support team. However, some people mentioned sign ificant delivery delays and long wait times for their custom orders to arrive. A few other people also felt that the delivery service fell short due to unhelpful couriers, damaged packaging, or unfulfilled room placement requests. Some reviewers were not happy with communication difficulties and slow responses when trying to resolve these specific problems.See more
